title: Tax ID Input
summary: Catches mistyped GSTIN, PAN and EU VAT numbers by checking their structure and the GSTIN check character, and pointing at the wrong character.
description: Tax number field for GSTIN, PAN and EU VAT that recomputes the GSTIN's mod-36 check character, reads back state, holder type and country, and pinpoints the wrong character with a one-tap fix for look-alikes, swaps and GR instead of EL.
catches: GSTIN check character that doesn't match (mod-36)
Look-alike characters (O/0, I/1) and swapped neighbours
State code, PAN holder type and EU country read back
EU VAT body shape per country, and GR typed instead of EL
Wrong length for the chosen kind
limits: Format looks valid ≠ registered: it does not confirm the number exists or is active
Use the GST portal or VIES to verify registration
EU VAT patterns check structure, not national check digits
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid with status via aria-describedby
Status and fixes in a polite live region
After a fix, focus returns to the input
External verify link has visible text
server: Verify GSTIN/VAT registration with the official service server-side before issuing tax invoices.

rules.note: GSTIN check-character algorithm, GST state codes, PAN 4th-character holder types and EU VAT body patterns were not re-verified against a primary source this round. Informational; verify registration with the GST portal or VIES.

stops: Invoice sent with a mistyped GSTIN
